diagram.title: The specialization key separates changing data from program choices
diagram.prediction: If only the array entries change, which ledger fields remain fixed?
diagram.reading: The first two calls carry different runtime arrays through one matching structural signature. A shape or static-mode change creates a different specialization request. The table describes this lesson’s call ledger; JAX cache behavior can also depend on other details, so do not read it as a universal compilation counter.
diagram.alt: Calls with shape (3,), float32 and static mode sum share the same signature even though their values and sums differ. Shape (4,) and mode mean each introduce a different signature.
diagram.scope: Signature-to-trace ledger for the lesson calls.
